title: Mediterranean Olive Spread with Vegan Feta
title_ru: Средиземноморская паста из оливок с веганской фетой
summary: A 5-minute blender spread of brined olives, vegan feta, parsley and pine nuts. No salt and no lemon needed.

nutrition.basis: per 100 g, vegan feta version (tofu version ≈185 kcal)

ingredients.name: Brined olives (green, black or mixed), drained
Vegan feta or salted firm tofu

steps: Drain the olives and pat them dry, otherwise the spread turns runny. If using tofu, press it and salt it.
Optionally toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes.
Put the olives, feta (or tofu), parsley, pine nuts, pepper and olive oil into a blender or food processor.
Blend until smooth, or leave it slightly chunky for texture.
Taste and add more pepper if needed. No salt needed.
Serve with toasted bread, crackers or fresh vegetables.
tips: Do not add lemon juice: the brine already gives enough acidity, lemon overpowers the flavor.
No added salt — olives and feta are already salty.
storage: Refrigerate in a closed jar for 3–4 days.
